description: Saves a company's press release as a draft in the signed-in account and checks it: length, structure, links, image size and content. Use when the user has company news to announce, for example a product launch, a new feature, a partnership or funding, including news they just wrote about in a blog post or article in this chat. Draft the whole release yourself from the chat. The company, press contact and spokesperson come from the account when you leave them out. Send the image too: image_url, or image_file for a file attached in the chat, with image_is_ai true when it was made with AI. LivePublicator does not change the text. Returns every problem to fix at once, or a private preview link and an edit link. It does not publish and uses no credit. Agencies name the client company and set client_authorized to true.

body.description: The release body, 250 to 1,000 words, as text, Markdown or HTML. Do not repeat the headline. 3 links at most.

client_authorized.description: Agencies: true confirms the client company agreed that you publish this release for it.

company_name.description: The company the news is about.

contact_name.description: Press contact's name, shown for journalists.

faq.description: Optional: up to 6 questions and answers.

headline.description: One line, 10 to 200 characters. Name the company in it.

image_file.description: Optional: an image file the user attached in the chat.

image_is_ai.description: true when the image was made with AI (for example by you, at the user's request). The page then labels it "Illustration, created with AI".

image_url.description: Optional: a public https URL of a cover image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB), for example from the company's website or blog post. 1200 px wide or more fills the page; from 600 px it shows at its own size. Under 600 px the release uses the cover card.

key_facts.description: 1 to 8 short facts, 5 to 200 characters each.

publish_at.description: Optional: when to go live, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-11-03T14:00:00Z), up to 60 days ahead.

quote.description: A quote from a real person at the company. More quotes can go in the body.

quote_name.description: Full name of the person quoted.

quote_title.description: Role of the person quoted, e.g. Founder and CEO.

summary.description: One sentence that sums up the news (40 to 300 characters).

name: create_release
title: Save a draft
